(4) Residential Uses
a) Multi-family dwelling.
b) Hotel or motel.
(5) Entertainment and Recreational Uses
a) Indoor commercial entertainment establishments including but not limited to cinema, theater, concert hall, cabaret and night club.
b) Recreation facilities including bowling alley, indoor or outdoor tennis courts, public recreation building, health club, or skating rink. Such recreation facilities shall be allowed only if they are located in or attached to structures containing other principal uses.
c) Halls, auditoriums and similar spaces used for public gatherings. 
d) Parks or playgrounds.
(6) Institutional Uses
a) Religious purposes.
b) Educational purposes exempt by statute.
c) Library or museum as an accessory use only.
d) Governmental offices and facilities, including post office, fire station and police station.
